beats.caption: Mullanasole. Here is the story of Mullanasole and its 22 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 103, 86 and 55 people in Mullanasole, in 25, 22 and 12 households. Heads of household included Likely, Connolly and Martin.
